replacement.sketch: No observability change required: the recording tracer is the subject and must survive runner adoption. Assertions distinguish filtered parameters from retained tool identity, with no logger replacement or shared capture state.

If initialize/list/call processing stalls, Deferred.await never reaches the existing stdout assertions. Record the last completed stage and sanitized protocol request ID through the accepted opt-in runner context so a watchdog failure identifies the stalled handshake. Preserve TestEnv, response assertions and joined teardown; do not log credentials or arbitrary tool arguments.
